description.zh:
想要触发的命令名称。
>调用[DescribeSophonCommands](~~DescribeSophonCommands~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The name of the command to trigger.

> Call the [DescribeSophonCommands](~~DescribeSophonCommands~~) operation to obtain the command name.

description.zh: 触发命令或剧本的输入参数。
description.en: The input parameters to trigger the command or playbook.

description.zh: 业务的自定义ID，如果触发剧本时不指定，会产生一个随机的ID，用于排查与定位问题。
description.en: A custom ID for the task. If you do not specify this parameter when you trigger the playbook, a random ID is generated. You can use the ID to locate and troubleshoot issues.

description.zh:
触发类型，取值：

- **command**：触发命令任务
- **playbook**：触发剧本任务
description.en:
The trigger type. Valid values:

- **command**: triggers a command task

- **playbook**: triggers a playbook task

description.zh:
剧本的UUID。
>调用[DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The UUID of the playbook.

> Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain the playbook UUID.

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解响应编排产品的收费方式和[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/sas/detail/sas)。
descriptions.en: Before calling this operation, ensure you understand the billing methods and [pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/sas/detail/sas) for response orchestration.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sophonsoar trigger-sophon-playbook --command-name waf_process_command --input-params param1_:_xx.xx.xx.xx_,_param2_:_7d --sophon-task-id f916b93e-e814-459f-9662-xxxxxxxxxx --uuid f916b93e-e814-459f-9662-xxxxxxxxxx --trigger-type playbook --api-version 2022-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sophonsoar TriggerSophonPlaybook --region cn-hangzhou --TriggerType playbook --InputParams 'param1_:_xx.xx.xx.xx_,_param2_:_7d' --Uuid 'f916b93e-e814-459f-9662-xxxxxxxxxx' --SophonTaskId 'f916b93e-e814-459f-9662-xxxxxxxxxx' --CommandName waf_process_command
